title: Lilly takes oral obesity race abroad with UK launch of Foundayo
snippet: Eli Lilly’s best play for Foundayo is to bring it overseas, a more price-sensitive market where the pharma can more readily outcompete Novo Nordisk “given the high margins of a small-molecule therapy,” Truist analyst Srikripa Devarakonda told BioSpace.

title: Massachusetts biopharma jobs, including R&D positions, fell in 2025: Report
snippet: After barely growing in 2024, biopharma employment in Massachusetts dropped 3.1% last year. R&D jobs dipped even more, by 3.9%. Biomanufacturing, however, went up.
